data.text: I appreciate everyone looking out for me, but I already committed to 6 tons this month, and I’ll honor that. Kate, Jack, and Emma, I respect your choices of 10 each. John, would you accept 14 this month instead? With my 6 and their 30, that totals 50 tons, leaving 50 to replenish to 100. You’d earn $14,000 and I’d earn $6,000. My reduction is voluntary, with no obligation for anyone to repay it later. Would that arrangement be acceptable to everyone?
